programme.title: The Ipswich Way : PL Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season. As a new chapter begins with Gary O'Neil following the successful reign of Kieran McKenna, we explore how the spirit, identity and ambition of Ipswich Town continues to shape its future.

programme.title: Matt Holland: Ipswich 00/01 : Rewind
programme.desc: Matt Holland reflects on Ipswich Town's remarkable 00/01 campaign, as the Tractor Boys follow up promotion with a remarkable run to European qualification.

programme.title: Fri 14 Aug : Fantasy Show
programme.desc: Haaland or Ekitike? Saka or Palmer? Cunha or Joao Pedro? Picking your Fantasy team is never easy, but the Fantasy Show is on hand to help FPL Managers with those big decisions.

programme.title: The Big Interview
programme.desc: Extended sit-downs and more informal 'out and about' interview with the Premier League's biggest stars, providing players with a platform to tell their story in their own words.

programme.title: Coventry Rising : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Malaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.? Alongside the preparations for the future, we reflect on the remarkable journey that has brought the Sky Blues back to the Premier League. From unforgettable highs to painful setbacks, financial turmoil to remarkable resurgence, we explore the defining moments that have shaped one of English football's most resilient clubs.

programme.title: Remembering Kevin Keegan : PL Moments
programme.desc: With Les Ferdinand and Shay Given. PL Moments combines archive and first-person testimony to revisit the very best games, goals, players and performances from the Premier League era.

programme.title: 2026/2027 : Preview Of The Season
programme.desc: The Premier League is back! Who will challenge for the title? Who can live up to the hype? And who has it all to prove? Preview of the Season will assess every club and hear from all the big names ahead of a thrilling 2026/27 campaign.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Haaland) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.title: Pororo Nursery Rhymes
programme.desc: Yuk, pelajari kisah seru Pororo dan kawan-kawan lewat lagu! Bagaimana kalau kita mencari tahu apa yang terjadi pada Pororo dan teman-temannya hari ini?

programme.title: MASHA AND THE BEAR
programme.desc: Seekor beruang sirkus pensiunan menetap di hutan dan bersiap untuk kehidupan baru yang tenang dikelilingi oleh kedamaian dan ketenangan sampai dia diperkenalkan dengan seorang gadis kecil petualang bernama Masha. Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: Doby And Disy - Hello Dreams
programme.desc: Mimpi mendorong kita untuk menciptakan masa depan yang lebih baik! Suatu hari di Hutan Sinar Matahari, Doby dan Disy mengetahui bahwa teman-teman mereka tidak bangun setelah tertidur. Jadi, mereka memutuskan untuk masuk ke dalam mimpi teman-temannya untuk menyelamatkan mereka dan di sana, mereka bertemu dengan Peri Mimpi.

programme.title: CoComelon English
programme.desc: Pelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, dan lainnya dengan JJ dalam serial musik yang menghadirkan saat-saat menyenangkan dengan sajak anak-anak untuk seluruh keluarga

programme.title: Little Baby Bum - Core Song English
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum adalah acara yang menyenangkan dan mendidik untuk anak-anak yang menampilkan lagu anak-anak klasik dan baru. Bersama teman dan keluarganya, Mia yang berusia 6 tahun mengalami dunia di sekitarnya melalui lagu dan terkadang sedikit sihir juga.

programme.title: Dino Pororo
programme.desc: Crong selalu bertanya-tanya jenis dinosaurus apa dia! Suatu hari, ketika Pororo dan Crong sedang membaca buku, mereka tersedot ke dalam buku dinosaurus. Di dunia dinosaurus, bisakah Crong mengetahui jenis dinosaurus apa dia? Bisakah Pororo dan Crong kembali dengan selamat dari dunia dinosaurus?

programme.title: Masha's?Nursery?Rhymes
programme.desc: Pelajari kisah seru Masha dan teman-temannya lewat lagu dan nyanyian!

programme.title: Color Activities with Pororo
programme.desc: Ada begitu banyak warna di sekitar kita! Mari bergabung dengan Pororo dan teman-temannya untuk melakukan aktivitas warna yang menyenangkan dan mengasyikkan. Temukan, mainkan, dan pelajari semua tentang warna bersama-sama!

programme.title: Pororo's Thematic Show
programme.desc: Tema cerita Pororo dan kawan-kawan. Anda akan diajak ke desa Porong Porong, sebuah tempat yang penuh dengan petualangan.

programme.title: PORORO
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Pororo's Healthy Habits
programme.desc: Halo teman-teman? Saya Pororo! Bisakah kita belajar bersama tentang bagaimana tumbuh sebagai anak yang sehat?

programme.title: Tayo & The Animal Rescue
programme.desc: Suatu hari, Tayo, Duri, dan Dana menemukan sebuah walkie-talkie aneh di dalam bus. Mereka mendengar sinyal darurat hewan yang terancam bahaya dari walkie-talkie tersebut, tetapi orang dewasa tidak dapat mendengarnya. Tayo, Duri, dan Dana memutuskan untuk menjadi "Para Penyelamat Hewan" dan pergi menyelamatkan hewan-hewan yang terancam bahaya di seluruh kota!

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru - seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Pokemon

programme.desc: Twelve year-old Chloe is feeling somewhat disillusioned. Then Potobot, a little robot arrives from the future with a mission for her: to change the world and make the future a better place. There's no doubt about it, working together, one step after another, the two of them can move mountains!

programme.title: Cirkus
programme.desc: Aria would love to spend a wonderful summer... Her wish comes true when a circus troupe sets up camp in her village.

programme.title: Foot Go
programme.desc: Eight year-old Tata arrives in a new school. She wants to join its football team but isn't allowed to; after all she's a girl! Refusing to be beaten, Tata decides to set up her own girls' team with the help of her gang of friends.

programme.title: Les Super-Pouvoirs Du Vivant
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is brimming with creatures that have extraordinary powers. To reveal the incredible inventiveness of nature and the importance of protecting it, each episode takes us on a fascinating journey rich in poetry and humour.

programme.title: Matiere Grise
programme.desc: The magazine programme which takes the mystery out of science, encouraging us to think... without all the brain work!

programme.title: Dans La Bulle De...
programme.desc: A timeless artist takes on the game of the five senses. Frederic Francois has been singing about love, in French, for more than fifty-five years! We know him well as an exception in the musical landscape, but what more can this experiment reveal about his personality?

programme.title: Secrets Des Profondeurs
programme.desc: Sam and Mario visit the Sorel Islands to reveal what is probably one of Canada's largest ship graveyards.

programme.title: Le Beau Velo De Ravel
programme.desc: A bike journey along the entire RAVeL network, an independent cycle path network in Wallonia. With each programme, the presenter tells us of a stage in his journey and talks about mobility and tourist resources in the region.

programme.title: La Belle Vie
programme.desc: Julien meets Joanie and Hugues, two former members of the armed forces, just a few days be-fore they set sail for the southern seas. Aboard their catamaran, they plan to spend five years seeking out the finest kitesurfing spots around the globe.

programme.title: Au Bonheur Des Livres
programme.desc: Around a chosen theme, Claire Chazal welcomes two authors: novelists, biographers, essayists or historians, and shares viewers' literary favorites.

programme.title: Rassemblance
programme.desc: They are behind the fashion house On aura tout vu, based in Paris since 1998. Livia Stoianova and Yassen Samouilov blend fashion, art and performance, exploring excess, diversion and visual poetry. Their unexpected creations, nourished by their Bulgarian heritage and migratory journey, have seduced Beyonce and Lady Gaga.

programme.title: Le Match Dans Le Match
programme.desc: He finished 13th in the alpine combined at the 2022 Beijing Olympic Games, where he was also the flag bearer for the Monegasque delegation: skier Arnaud Alessandria is Sebastien Serrano's guest.

programme.title: Le Telejournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Les Routes Du Gout
programme.desc: An intimate and gourmet meeting in the heart of Campania. Michelin-starred chef Alfonso Iaccarino opens the doors of Don Alfonso 1890, a temple of Mediterranean cuisine, where a family tradition spanning five generations continues. An opportunity to taste cuisine deeply rooted in terroir.

programme.title: Chateau !
programme.desc: At the royal estate of Chateau-Gaillard, a very special plum was born: the "Reine-Claude", named in honor of King Francis I's wife.

programme.title: La Fievre Des Festivals
programme.desc: For organizers, after long weeks of work and tension, the end of a festival is always an emotional time. It's also an opportunity to offer one last moment of joy to the audience and to celebrate the event as a team, before gathering again for a new edition.

programme.title: Alterrenative Voyages
programme.desc: We head to the town of Tozeur to lift the mystery on its architecture. And, in the mountainous region of Dahar, we meet Mohamed Sadok, chairman of the authentic tourism federation Destination Dahar, which supports environmentally conscious and alternative projects.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi
programme.desc: The Lenotre cookery school, passing on the passion for the culinary arts that drove its founder, the illustrious Gaston Lenotre. A footwear institution that bears the name of a London district: the Chelsea boot. FONT&ROMANI or the art of high-end rug-making using the Savonnerie technique. The elegance of draping.

programme.title: L'Epicerie
programme.desc: The place to be for all those who are interested in what they put on their plates and all things relating to food. The programme: reports, surveys, taste tests, test benches, answers to questions from television viewers, including advice and simple but effective tricks.

programme.title: Questions Pour Un Champion
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: A Boire Et A Manger
programme.desc: In Kamouraska, Lindsay combines to perfection the rich flavour of Haiti with that of the Lower Saint-Lawrence, to the total delight of her co-presenters. Today, actors and friends Eve Landry and Melissa Bedard join them around the table.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Les Victoires Du Jazz 2025
programme.desc: 23rd edition of Les Victoires du Jazz! A ceremony, under the honorary presidency of Angelique Kidjo, during which six Victoires were awarded, recognising the instrumental artist, vocal artist, breakthrough artist, album, concert and world music album of the year. The opportunity to savour fantastic performances!

programme.title: La Faune Connectee
programme.desc: Each winter, Northern map turtles hibernate under the ice on Opinicon Lake, with no access to air. In the face of climate warming and sound pollution, they have become essential allies for biologists, helped by recent technologies to study how they adapt.

programme.title: Les Secrets Du Finistere
programme.desc: Evelyne Bouix, Jeremy Banster, Myriam Bourguignon, Yannig Samot

programme.title: Alterrenative Voyages
programme.desc: We're off to Brignoles in the Var to meet Corinne Lafortune, Circular Economy Project Coordinator at Ecoscience Provence. The association's primary objective is to reduce waste! We also visited the Bulles de Coco eco-friendly soap factory and the La Courtoisie recycling centre.
